lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly parallel horizontal tiers. The mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin displays a cluster of 8-12 primary nodes with higher pixel intensity than surrounding smaller speckles.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Low-contrast vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid where the brightest pixel clusters serve as vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent linear features exhibit a high-frequency contrast change (light-to-dark gradient) running horizontally across the mid-to-upper flank, defining the lateral ridges.
